title: balance pokemon type read model
description: The pokemonId -> types read model consumed by BALANCE_POKEMON_TYPES_PATH (ADR-0014 §2), extended with the optional nameJa/abilityIds catalog fields (ADR-0401 §5). This is the canonical shape the data lane's `pokedex export` must produce; services/balance/internal/master/pokemon_types.go is the executable version of the same contract. Not expressible here: pokemonId must be unique across `pokemon` entries (a cross-array uniqueness constraint); the loader rejects duplicates, this schema does not.

schemaVersion.description: The only accepted value. A future incompatible shape bumps this.

nameJa.description: Omitted and null both mean absent (ADR-0401 §7.5); the minLength/maxLength only apply when the value is a string.

abilityIds.description: Omitted, null and [] all decode to the same empty result (ADR-0401 §5/§7.5).
